findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_savings_recommendations, query_events, list_tracker_links, get_remediation_impact, list_alert_channels · Private data: query_costs, list_dashboard_widget_catalog, query_usage, list_repo_cost_mappings, list_alert_channels, get_gcp_usage_settings · Public sink: list_savings_recommendations, list_cost_tags, list_anomalies, explain_cost_change, query_unit_costs, list_alert_channels, preview_alert_baseline, list_alert_deliveries, list_alert_history · Destructive: list_savings_recommendations, list_anomalies, list_data_health, list_cost_tag_rules, list_budgets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_savings_recommendations, query_events, list_tracker_links, get_remediation_impact, list_alert_channels · Private data: query_costs, list_dashboard_widget_catalog, query_usage, list_repo_cost_mappings, list_alert_channels, get_gcp_usage_settings · Public sink: list_savings_recommendations, list_cost_tags, list_anomalies, explain_cost_change, query_unit_costs, list_alert_channels, preview_alert_baseline, list_alert_deliveries, list_alert_history · Destructive: list_savings_recommendations, list_anomalies, list_data_health, list_cost_tag_rules, list_budgets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
